text: Britain planned to fight U-boats with an aircraft carrier made of ice.
U-boats were hunting convoys where planes couldn't reach.
Inventor Geoffrey Pyke's fix: a floating airfield, made of ice.
Pykrete: wood pulp mixed with water, then frozen.
It would have been the biggest ship ever.
at a 1943 conference, Mountbatten reportedly fired his pistol at a block of it.
A prototype was built on Patricia Lake, Canada, chilled by a one-horsepower motor.
But costs ballooned, and longer-range planes closed the gap.
By the end of 1943, the ice ship was shelved.
The real ship was never built.
The prototype took three summers to melt.
